requires: B #762 original runtime and trusted export
same original API and tools as A
approved G training and frozen model/template/tokenizer hashes
same B harness and tool schema

execution_gate.missing_C: report C UNRUN; ready A/B may proceed under their separately granted execution goal
execution_gate.this_goal: registration only; actual comparison requires a later goal
execution_gate.candidate_selection: E freezes exactly one candidate using development/validation before final access; keep all search/failed candidates

scoring.rule: freeze the controlled scoring adapter against the same hard checks before unsealing; changes require a new plan and independent review

samples.family_rule: complete tasks and all languages/rewrites stay together; controlled-side content/lineage de-duplication against public development, validation and teacher data
samples.author_exposure: D compiles before sealing using jointly reviewed D/R rules; author exposure is disclosed; post-seal decryption refusal does not prove author blindness
samples.historical_C_evaluation: C #32 original 33 pairs / 66 cases and 11 fixed holdout retain their original identities, denominators and failures; this additional set is reported separately
samples.final_access: JT alone retains passphrase; only an explicitly authorized R comparison session may receive it; developers and optimizer receive ciphertext/metadata only
samples.no_adaptation: no prompt, scorer, teacher or student tuning after final exposure; retain original failures; a new attempt requires independent re-registration

environment.code_tools_models_hashes: freeze exact code, prompt, model, tool schema, adapter, dependencies, candidate and data digests in a run manifest before execution
environment.same_environment: same B exit, identity policy, environment, tool versions and facts/source cut-off across paired groups
environment.ordering: one primary attempt per task/language/group; fixed round-robin A/B/C order rotates by sorted task identity; seed G2C-harness-comparison-plan.1
environment.writes: fresh signed local sandbox PG per task/group for state-changing controls; external production write tools disabled in shadow comparison
environment.network_and_cost: actual external model/read-only tool requests only through B original identity and unique Meter, within separately approved #495 scope
environment.latency_origin: same client monotonic clock from actual submission to App-rendered server progress, first body and complete answer; source-only prefixes and animations excluded

task_completion.denominator: PASS+FAIL+UNKNOWN among started first attempts, following the existing quality policy; planned N and UNRUN are reported separately; any UNRUN prevents PASS

metrics.timing_population: nearest-rank full planned population per group/language; missing clocks UNKNOWN, known-subset diagnostics cannot certify PASS
metrics.cost: per task and full batch, original model/tool/reflection attempts, known estimated/reserved totals and actual billed totals separately; missing receipts UNKNOWN

improvement.primary: independently certified task PASS count on identical planned paired cells
improvement.rule: candidate must meet every existing quality gate, have zero hard errors and zero new hard failures, and be no worse in either language or any behavior class; at least one language must have strictly more primary PASS than its paired reference
comparisons: C versus B when C is ready; C versus A also reported
improvement.unchanged_or_incomplete: no recommendation when no strict task improvement or required evidence is UNKNOWN/UNRUN; latency/cost differences remain separate diagnostics
improvement.statistics: report paired wins/losses/ties and uncertainty; no unregistered statistical significance or effect-size threshold

stop_and_resume.hard_failure: stop that candidate, preserve its failure and all remaining planned UNRUN cells; no promotion
stop_and_resume.unknown_write_or_charge: stop new dispatches and candidate selection; keep original attempt/RUN/op; B read-only reconciliation before any authorized recovery; no new-ID resend
stop_and_resume.resource: no execution without concrete approved B window, expiry, call/amount ceiling and stop thresholds; stop at the earliest exhausted limit, never reset prior holds
stop_and_resume.drift: stop on code/model/tool/data/scorer drift, missing provenance, corrupted artifact, final leakage or decryption outside the authorized R session
stop_and_resume.rerun: all reruns stored separately; first attempt determines primary result; never replace failures by the best rerun

publication.public: only versions, aggregate per-language/behavior denominators, outcomes, failure classes, metadata hashes and authorized evidence references; no final task text, answers or per-item answer hashes
publication.custody: ciphertext outside repository; no plaintext in repository, Issue, shared worktree or CI artifacts; secret not in argv, environment snapshots or logs
publication.decision: R independently records passed, failed or insufficient evidence; recommendation does not close product #32/#702/#29/#33 or authorize deployment
publication.controlled_path: R authorized session decrypts and runs frozen software in its controlled process; raw task text, answers, inputs and outputs remain controlled; D/E/B receive permitted aggregate metadata only
